title: ARWP Adaptive Site Upgrade Intelligence
purpose: Compile source-backed Search, AI-search, citation, dataset, agent and measurement guidance into target-site change recipes. This registry extends the recommendation registry with implementation intelligence; it is not a ranking-factor catalog.

automationClasses.mechanical: A deterministic repository change may eventually be auto-applied after repository-specific verification.
automationClasses.grounded-template: ARWP can prepare structure or snippets, but factual values must be grounded in the target site.
automationClasses.policy-gated: The change expresses publisher policy or rights and requires explicit owner review.
automationClasses.editorial: Human/editorial judgment is required; ARWP can identify the gap and evidence contract but must not manufacture experience or expertise.
automationClasses.owner-platform: Authenticated external platform state is required and cannot be inferred from public crawling.
automationClasses.runtime: The recommendation concerns interactive agent behavior and needs browser/runtime evaluation.

recipe: Remove unintended crawl/index/snippet blockers from priority public URLs.
Keep canonical URLs, HTTP status and internal href links unambiguous.
Keep important page content available as rendered text.
Publish accurate sitemap lastmod only for meaningful changes.

verification.successState: Priority pages are technically eligible for the intended Search surfaces; eligibility is not an indexing or ranking guarantee.

recipe: Lead with a directly useful answer or decision context instead of generic introductory filler.
Add first-hand evidence, original examples, data, methodology or a distinct conclusion where truthful.
Use descriptive headings and stable fragment IDs for evidence-bearing sections.
Make claims traceable to primary or appropriately authoritative sources.
Do not manufacture query-variant pages or AI-only text blocks.

verification.successState: The page contains human-useful, addressable evidence that can be retrieved without inventing special AI markup.

recipe: Choose one canonical Person/Organization/Product/Dataset identity per real entity.
Link visible bylines and product/dataset facts to stable identity pages.
Use sameAs only for identities actually controlled by or clearly representing the entity.
Keep machine-readable identity facts consistent with visible page facts.

verification.successState: Important creators, products and datasets resolve to stable, non-conflicting identities.

packs.title: ChatGPT Search discovery separated from training policy

recipe: If ChatGPT Search visibility is desired, ensure OAI-SearchBot is not unintentionally blocked for intended public content.
Set GPTBot training preference independently; do not treat search discovery and model training as one switch.
Preserve noindex where the publisher does not want a page surfaced even as a bare link.

verification.successState: Search discovery and training preferences match explicit publisher intent.

packs.title: Interactive pages operable through semantic accessibility signals

recipe: Prefer native semantic HTML for controls and navigation.
Add descriptive accessible names, roles, states and label associations where native semantics are insufficient.
Remove click-only non-semantic interaction traps and unstable layout shifts around key actions.
Test real task completion at narrow viewport sizes and through the accessibility tree.

verification.successState: Key user tasks expose stable semantics that both assistive technology and browser agents can interpret.

packs.title: Publish real data products as citable, versioned dataset releases
packs.condition: Only for a genuine reusable/distributable corpus. Never create a decorative dataset solely to pass ARWP.

recipe: Define a stable dataset identity, creator/publisher, scope, license, methodology, limitations and version.
Freeze the release distributions and record SHA-256 checksums before archive publication.
Publish the release through an archival repository such as Zenodo when appropriate and verify the issued DOI before exposing it as canonical citation metadata.
Link versions and related outputs using persistent identifiers where available; DataCite 4.7 can relate DOI records to SWHIDs.
Keep DOI state explicit as not-issued until an external resolver confirms it.

verification.successState: A real dataset release is independently resolvable and citable; DOI presence is not treated as a ranking factor or quality certificate.

signals: AI citations to dataset landing/research pages

packs.title: Expose Google Preferred Sources for repeat-reader sites
packs.condition: Use only when a repeat-reader relationship is plausible and the site can be selected at domain/subdomain level.

targets: site header/footer or relevant editorial surface
recipe: Add the official Preferred Sources control or documented source-selection link in a context where returning readers can understand it.
Do not describe the control as a general ranking boost.

verification.successState: Users can intentionally select the site as a Preferred Source where Google supports the feature.

packs.title: Close the loop with Google generative Search owner data

recipe: Capture a pre-change baseline for relevant pages and dates.
Import generative Search and Discover visibility data after material changes.
Compare observation windows without claiming that a site change caused the movement.

verification.successState: Implementation state and Google generative visibility are tracked as separate evidence classes.

packs.title: Turn Bing AI citations, grounding queries, intents and topics into the next content backlog

recipe: Import cited pages and grounding-query exports.
Where available, preserve Bing intent, topic, Citation Share and compare-period fields as owner-side evidence rather than generic SEO scores.
Map grounding queries and topics to existing canonical pages before proposing new content.
Create new content recommendations only for real unmet user intent or missing evidence depth; avoid one-page-per-query factories.
Use Citation Share as relative citation presence, not ranking, authority or causality.

verification.successState: AI citation observations generate a traceable, non-spammy next experiment backlog.

packs.title: Declare AI content-use intent without pretending it is universal
packs.condition: Provider-specific. Apply only where the target delivery stack or intended consumers support the mechanism.

recipe: Express search/reference/training preferences only after publisher rights and distribution intent are clear.
Keep provider-specific Content Signals separate from Google/OpenAI crawler semantics.
Record why the selected use level is appropriate for the site.

verification.successState: Content-use policy is explicit, scoped and not misrepresented as a universal web standard.

packs.title: Expose agent/API interfaces only when there is a real capability
packs.condition: Absence is not a defect when the product exposes no safe agent/API capability.

recipe: Start from an implemented task/capability, not from a fashionable discovery file.
Publish the smallest truthful discovery contract that maps to the runtime capability.
Keep static declaration evidence separate from successful runtime task evidence.

verification.successState: Agent discovery leads to a real, appropriately scoped capability rather than a dead manifest.

packs.title: Preserve why every site change was recommended and whether it worked

recipe: Record the upstream source/rule version that caused the recommendation.
Record the exact target surfaces changed and the verification result.
Keep implementation success separate from Search/AI outcome evidence.
Preserve negative results and retire stale practices instead of silently deleting history.

verification.successState: Every applied recommendation is auditable from upstream evidence to target-site change and later outcome review.
